summary: Tim Credeur is a retired American mixed martial artist and a cast member of SpikeTV's "The Ultimate Fighter 7". He lost in the semi-finals to fellow cast member Jesse Taylor, but was reinstated after Taylor was disqualified. He then lost to C.B. Dollaway by decision in the bout for a spot in the finals.
one_line: Tim Credeur is a retired American mixed martial artist who competed on The Ultimate Fighter 7.
key_facts: Timothy Wallace Credeur II was born on July 9, 1977.
Tim Credeur is a retired American mixed martial artist.
Tim Credeur was a cast member of SpikeTV's "The Ultimate Fighter 7".
Tim Credeur was defeated by fellow cast member Jesse Taylor in the semi-finals of The Ultimate Fighter 7.
Tim Credeur was brought back into the competition after the disqualification of Jesse Taylor.
Tim Credeur fought C.B. Dollaway for a spot in the finals of The Ultimate Fighter 7.
Tim Credeur lost to C.B. Dollaway via decision in the bout for a spot in the finals.
